I also did not find a clean primary source showing a written coalition pact being honored or broken by Srettha beyond public support for the digital-wallet program and the later alliance shakeup after his dismissal.","evidence":[{"title":"Thai court to decide embattled PM Srettha’s fate on August 14","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"July 24, 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/world/thai-court-to-decide-embattled-pm-sretthas-fate-on-august-14/2188597/","summary":"Reuters reported that the case against Srettha stemmed from his appointment of Pichit Chuenban, and that if removed, parliament would elect a new premier. This supports a constitutional, rather than extra-constitutional, succession path, but it also shows his appointment choice had triggered a formal constitutional challenge.","question_ids":["4B.8","4B.5"]},{"title":"Thai politics braces for shakeup after court dismisses PM Srettha Thavisin","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"August 13-14, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/judgment-day-for-thai-pm-srettha-as-court-rules-on-dismissal-case-3570233","summary":"Reuters said Srettha’s dismissal could require parliament to elect a new premier and potentially reshape the governing alliance. That is evidence that succession still ran through constitutional institutions, but also that his coalition was fragile and the ruling alliance was unstable.","question_ids":["4B.8","4B.5"]},{"title":"Thai court removes Srettha Thavisin as prime minister after less than a year","publisher":"Reuters via The Guardian","date":"August 14, 2024","url":"https://www.theguardian.com/world/article/2024/aug/14/thailand-pm-srettha-thavisin-court-case-dismissal-ruling-judgment","summary":"Reuters reported that the Constitutional Court dismissed Srettha for appointing a former lawyer who had served jail time, and that this raised the prospect of political upheaval and a reset of the governing alliance. This is only weak, indirect evidence of coalition coordination, but it is the clearest 2024 sign I found that his government was still managing coalition commitments publicly.","question_ids":["4B.8","4B.2"]}]}
